messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@transcendhealth.com>; Raj Patel <raj.patel@transcendhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jul 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: 7/9 discovery — Transcend Health / Redwood (next steps & risks)

Elena / Raj — thanks again for the time today. Quick written recap so we have a single place to track outcomes, open risks, and next steps. Please flag anything I missed.

Summary of what we heard
- Primary business goal: reduce per-inference cost for real-time clinical decisioning while meeting strict 95th-percentile latency targets (<200ms for short prompts).
- Pain: current vendor costs and unpredictable burst pricing, model quality fluctuations during peak hours, and data residency constraints for identifiable PHI.
- KPIs you care about: inference cost/unit, 95p latency, error-rate on domain-specific prompts, and time-to-rollback for any model regression.

Proposed commercial / delivery outcomes
- 12-week pilot (Private deployment in your VPC) focused on diagnostic-assistant workload (50k daily requests).
- Target: 50–60% reduction in per-token/unit cost via batching, KV caching, and quantized model variant.
- Ops SLA for pilot: 99.5% uptime, fallback to hosted variant during infra incidents.

Top risks called out
1) Security/compliance: need SOC 2 evidence + clarity on data at rest encryption and KMS.
2) Procurement: Transcend requires a PO + standard redline around data ownership and right-to-audit.
3) Integration: SSO/SAML and SCIM expected by Aug 1 for pilot readiness.
4) Model-quality regressions on edge prompts — we suggest a prompt suite for regression monitoring and a fast rollback policy.

Immediate next steps (owner / ETA)
- Redwood to share SOC2 summary + MAP (Mutual Action Plan) draft (attached) — owner: Mina — by Wed 7/11.
- Transcend to confirm procurement path and budget owner. Raj to share PO timeline — by Fri 7/14.
- Technical sync to scope SSO + VPC networking (Redwood infra + Transcend cloud infra) — propose Thu 7/13 at 9am PT — owner: Laura.
- Provide a short one-pager for the C-suite outlining business outcomes and cost impact — owner: Ben — by Tue 7/12.

Attachments included: SOC2-Summary.pdf (summary page), Mutual-Action-Plan-draft.xlsx (Gantt-style plan).

If this reads right, I’ll move the MAP into Drive and schedule the SSO/infra call for Thu 7/13.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
